objective: Localize the first later cheap-policy mechanism that restores the AM witness after exact DP and an inert R33 pass. Replay the frozen policy order without changing it, measure AI-class membership after each microstage, and preserve a counterexample if the previously observed recovery cannot be reproduced.

forensic_protocol.exact_DP: Reconstruct the frozen parent witness from the inherited deterministic generator/route, apply pivot 9 with the existing exact-DP implementation, require exact hash/CLV and independent replay.
forensic_protocol.initial_R33: Require the AM observation to replay: STALLED_STACK_LEAN_CORE, zero R33 rule applications, unchanged child hash/CLV.
forensic_protocol.main_route: Continue the exact frozen X/W policy order. After every RUP application, every R33 restart, and every SA-BVE application, record canonical hash, CLV, AI-class pass/slack, terminal state, proof object, and independent replay status. Stop at the earliest AI-class reentry or terminal, while also replaying the inherited full policy to its known recovery state for consistency.
forensic_protocol.counterfactual_SA_BVE: At the raw exact-DP child only, independently ask whether a frozen SA-BVE candidate exists if the RUP priority is bypassed. If one exists, replay it and record its class effect. This counterfactual is diagnostic only and must not alter the main-route verdict or policy.
forensic_protocol.causal_classification: Distinguish RUP_DIRECT_REENTRY, RUP_UNLOCKS_R33_REENTRY, MULTI_RUP_RESTART_CHAIN, SA_BVE_REQUIRED, or RECOVERY_NOT_REPRODUCED from the first class-reentry stage. Do not infer universal necessity from one witness.

pass_condition: Frozen parent/raw-child controls replay exactly; the inherited later cheap-policy route reproduces the known self-preserving recovery; the earliest class-reentry stage is uniquely classified with proof-carrying records and all independent replay checks passing.
result_policy: AN is a single-witness mechanism-forensics gate. It may identify a necessary operator under the frozen route ordering, but that is not a universal theorem. No new reduction rule or changed priority may be introduced after seeing the route.
